description: Client-side script for managing the Timesheet form in ERPNext, including setup, validation, button actions, and calculations related to time logs, billing, and project associations.

methods.name: calculate_end_time
methods.description: Calculates the 'to_time' based on 'from_time' and 'hours', setting 'from_time' if missing.

methods.name: update_billing_hours
methods.description: Sets 'billing_hours' to total hours if billable, otherwise zero.

methods.name: update_time_rates
methods.description: Sets 'billing_rate' to zero if not billable.

methods.name: calculate_billing_costing_amount
methods.description: Calculates billing and costing amounts, including base rates, considering exchange rate.

methods.name: calculate_time_and_amount
methods.description: Aggregates total hours, billable hours, and amounts from time logs and updates the form fields.

methods.name: set_employee_and_company
methods.description: Sets current employee and company based on logged-in user.

methods.name: set_project_in_timelog
methods.description: Assigns parent project to all time logs if parent project is set.
